نمتري (form VIII)
# نَمْتَرِي (namtarī) /nam.ta.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# نَمْتَرِيَ (namtariya) /nam.ta.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
